children: The CAC 40 closed little changed at 8,078 on Friday as lower oil prices and calmer bond markets supported equities, while losses in the luxury sector weighed on the index.
Reports that the US and Iran were exploring a agreement that could lead to the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz eased concerns over energy supply disruptions.
The pullback in oil offered respite to credit-sensitive sectors that have been under pressure from energy-driven inflation concerns.
Financial stocks rose, with BNP Paribas adding 0.9%, Crédit Agricole rising 1.4%, and Société Générale advancing 3.5%.
Meanwhile, luxury stocks closed lower amid renewed pressure from weaker Chinese demand, subdued consumer confidence, and softer earnings expectations.
Industrials closed mixed, with Airbus (-1%) and Thales (-1.2%) down, while Schneider Electric (+0.4%) and STMicroelectronics (+0.5%) gained, tracking gains from US chipmakers.
On the week, the CAC 40 shed 0.7%.

title: CAC 40 Little Changed as Luxury Stocks Weigh
